e02e8aa9dd.q: What is an ESOP and how do employees earn ownership stake in the company?
e02e8aa9dd.a: An ESOP stands for Employee Stock Ownership Plan and functions as a retirement plan where the plan owns the company and every employee is a participant. Employees earn ownership by showing up and doing their job every day. At year-end, company profits are distributed to employee owners. The company contributes about a quarter of each employee's salary annually into their retirement account as stock or cash. As company value increases, stock value increases, and employees can also receive dividends in good years.

c5098ec68e.q: Why is the federal gas tax structure inadequate for modern infrastructure funding needs?
c5098ec68e.a: The gas tax is a flat number of cents per gallon that has never changed since inception, unlike sales tax which scales with price.
